verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches message performance. The AI agent and MCP/CLI can "analyze performance" and "report on how your messages perform", can run scheduled recurring tasks such as deliverability reports and broadcast recaps, and automations include a Goals component that implies conversion tracking. Nothing documents a first-party analytics view of the specific metrics per campaign or per automation step over time. Missing for 10: documented opens/clicks/unsubscribes/conversions metrics, per-campaign and per-workflow-step reporting, time-series trends, independent or hands-on corroboration.
